decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds on the established offer, keeps its own page through 2024 and costs a distributor little to carry, so the option is still worth holding while its prospects resolve, especially as several other 2023 launches have already been cut.

The folding add-on unit is close to the core offer, has a documented customer installation, and complements existing machines at low carrying cost, so its value is not yet shown to be unrealized, though its lower visibility makes dropping somewhat more likely.
